Title: Admin home page shows the Home heading and the menu links
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/home.aspx as a signed-in admin user.
Step Expected: The page loads and no server error page is shown.

Step Action: Read the main heading of the page.
Look for the Home and Help links in the menu.
Step Expected: The links Home and Help are visible.

Step Action: Look for the System Administration, Manage Contracts and Manage Schemes links in the menu.
Step Expected: The links System Administration, Manage Contracts and Manage Schemes are visible.

Step Action: Look for the Distributions, Test Consultant, Assessor and Results Sign-off links in the menu.
Step Expected: The links Distributions, Test Consultant, Assessor and Results Sign-off are visible.

Step Action: Look for the System information link in the menu without selecting it.
Step Expected: The System information link is visible and the h1 is still Home.

Step Action: Use the browser Back button, then click the Test Consultant link and read the main heading.

Step Action: Use the browser Back button, then click the Assessor link and read the main heading.

Step Action: Use the browser Back button, then click the Results Sign-off link and read the main heading.
